item.title: Holy F*cked #2
item.description: We’re serving up a piping hot pile of excitement as a mild-mannered dinner party turns deadly! Jesus and Satan are hosting Maria and her new lover, Thanatos, over for an evening of camaraderie and conversation. But Thanatos isn’t actually Thanatos… he’s Hercules! And he wants to kill Jesus. Plus… introducing the righteous might of The New Apostles!

item.title: Holy F*cked #3
item.description: Hercules is driving a van full of explosives with Jesus tied up in the back. But he’s in for one hell of a ride because the New Apostles are out to stop him! Will Cosmic Moses, the Secret Pope, Mother 2resa, and the Holy Spirit halt Herc before he blows Jesus to kingdom come? Plus… can Maria get Satan to the hospital on time?
